name: painting
what: Painting cobalt on the body under a glaze (青花's 勾线 and 分水) and the firing's spread: the brush's laws that crafts/painting/paint.py turns into the cobalt map c(x, y), g CoO per m^2. Tags as docs/layers.md: M measured, I looked up, D derived, F fitted, A assumed.
not_found: S3 调研 (qinghua-s3 report section 5): no measured stroke widths, no transverse cobalt profile across a stroke, no edge-to-centre ratio, no pooling law, no concentration law for 分水. The workshop's 5, 7 or 9 named tones of 分水 [I, Palace Museum glossary; UMMA] are categories, not levels, so c is continuous here. Every law below is therefore our assumption, to be checked against photographs on the material card and fitted there [F].

land_mm.source: the length over which a landing brush presses from 40% to full width; not measured

lift_mm.source: the taper as the brush lifts to a point; not measured

load_drop.source: the fraction of a stroke's c lost from its start to its end as the brush empties; not measured

edge_mm.source: the width over which a stroke's deposit falls from full to none (the bristles' splay, the slurry wicking into the dry body); not measured. The firing's bleed adds to it

rim.source: the extra pigment at a wash's edge, as a fraction of its c (a pool dries last at its rim); 'an artistic hypothesis' per S3 调研, not established as a law for 分水

rim_mm.source: the rim's e-folding width inward; not measured

mottle.source: the relative standard deviation of a wash's slow variation (the pool's uneven settling); not measured

mottle_mm.source: the mottle's scale (Gaussian sigma of filtered noise); not measured

wash_edge_mm.source: the width of a wash's soft edge; not measured

line_c.source: outline pigment; with materials/qinghua's kappa a wide area of c = 3 under the glaze reads as a deep navy (blue/white 0.33, red/white 0.04, tests/qinghua/check_coat.py). No measured cobalt loading of a stroke was found; the card fits it [F, later]

wash_c.source: the span of 分水 from the palest 影淡 to the deep 头浓; as line_c

line_width_mm.source: a fine outline (勾线); typical stroke widths not found (S3 调研); the card's photograph measures them [M, later]
